certified.material: NIST SRM 191d (0.025 mol/kg NaHCO3 + 0.025 mol/kg Na2CO3, pH standard)
certified.method: primary Harned-cell emf (cells without liquid junction); pH(S) on the molality scale

headline.comparator: davies activity pH vs certified pH(S) 10.014 +/- 0.010 (U, k=1.96)
headline.status: MEASURED_CORROBORATED_WITHIN_U (blind prediction, zero fitted parameters; PARTIAL common-mode via the shared Debye-Huckel/Bates-Guggenheim activity-convention family -- NOT an independent derivation of K2)

caveats: PARTIAL common-mode: our K1/K2 are Harned-lineage and Davies shares the Debye-Huckel family with the certificate's Bates-Guggenheim convention (the certificate's dominant uncertainty, 0.0050 pH).
UNITS: 0.025 mol/kg molalities treated as mol/L (dilute; ~0.001-0.002 pH effect).
Na-carbonate ion pairs (NaCO3-, NaHCO3(0)) omitted from the carbonate base model (second-order here).
Only the 25 C row is validatable (the model is 25 C-sourced and fail-closes off-domain, XIX-1C).
